column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for the weather and structure record. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the location. FK to Location.STATION_name.
BIGINT. Reference to the operation and maintenance record. FK to OperationMaintenance.OP_MAINT_ID.
REAL. External temperature in Celsius. Example: -14.9.
REAL. Wind speed in meters per second. Example: 26.5.
REAL. Wind direction in degrees. **NULL means no wind direction data recorded.**. Example: 71.4.
REAL. Barometric pressure in hectopascals. Example: 975.3.
REAL. Solar radiation in watts per square meter. Example: 541.0.
BIGINT. Snow depth in centimeters. Example: 143.6.
REAL. Ice thickness in centimeters. Example: 254.4.
TEXT. Type of precipitation (e.g., rain, snow). **NULL means no precipitation type recorded.**. Possible values: Blowing Snow, Ice, Snow.
REAL. Precipitation rate in millimeters per hour. Example: 2.4.
BIGINT. Snow load in kilograms per square meter. Example: 459.7.
TEXT. Structural integrity status. **NULL means no structural integrity status recorded.**. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
REAL. Vibration level in millimeters squared. Example: 8.61.
REAL. Noise level in decibels. Example: 38.5.
